## Events

### Description
A collection of core events are defined within the package for use by the games. They're not all fired within the package so may need to be fired by the game at the required time but the package does listen to them to do certain things so they should be used where needed.

The game projects can define further events where needed, those defined here are only intended to cover common behaviour across all games such as BEGIN, STAKE_CHANGE, etc...

### Basic Usage
All the events are commented with when they fire (or should be fired by the game) and those comments are visible in intellisense when developing for ease of use.

Head to the [events file](../src/services/events.ts) to see all the events and their descriptions.

### Deprecation Layer
Previously we used a eventEmitter3 for our events but have switched to using the tombola package `@international-client/event`. THis provided better intellisense and helped to reduce code differences between departments.

The [Event Emitter File](../src/services/event-emitter.ts) is still in place for the time being to enable backward compatibility for those games that are still using the original API. The exported eventEmitter should not be used in new projects.
